'''''A Festive Gathering''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] that was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was created to commemorate a festive gathering. It depicted a group consisting of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] wielding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a [[blue]] blade, a male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], a female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], and a male [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] fending off an attack from three [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''A Festive Gathering'' appeared as a decoration for the player's house in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was a special incentive for those that attended the [[2007]] Star Wars Galaxies Community Summit held by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="FanFaire">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67321&month=072007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Star Wars Galaxies at Fan Faire 2007}}</ref>
